description: Lucht - Immissie verkeer prognose 2030 Stikstofdioxide (NO2) is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NationaalGeoregister.nl. Bestand geeft een prognose van de luchtkwaliteit inzake stikstofdioxide rond rijks, provinciale en gemeentelijke wegen in Gelderland voor het jaar 2030. De gegevens zijn landelijk doorgerekend met behulp van de Monitoringstool. Per wegvak is aangegeven wat de prognose is voor concentratie NO2 op 10 meter van de rand van de weg. Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal files it under the publisher NationaalGeoregister.nl. Its tags are data-product, immissies, laag, luchtkwaliteit, luchtverontreiniging. It offers 3 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/PNG, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WFS_SRVC, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WMS_SRVC. The portal shows 2026-08-13 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
